title: Qualify Batik lazy resources and original JDK properties decoding
description: On both ordered Batik deployments follow the actual Class.getResourceAsStream return into the original Properties.load, its LineReader refills and the first property read. Qualify fresh, memoized, same-path replaced and setter-first histories. On ordinary files distinguish Latin-1 and UTF-8 Reader input, escapes, continuations, duplicate precedence, partial failure and absence.

steps.name: Ten original file and reader histories
